class_balance: exactly equal counts for all 101 classes in every split
epoch_semantics: ceil(train_samples/global_batch_size) consecutive batches from the shuffled infinite sampler; approximately one full train pass
execution_cutoff_semantics: stop_after_epoch controls only one process invocation and is excluded from the protocol fingerprint; the optimizer and cosine horizon remain fixed at the configured 10 epochs
execution_schedule: global tokenizer barrier after every epoch: all 45 configurations finish checkpoint plus validation for epoch N before any starts epoch N+1
feature_microbatch_semantics: frozen backbone only; concatenate one FP32 [global_batch,D] tensor before linear heads

known_duplicate_configuration.clip_meta__l14: same checkpoint and feature surface as mc1_l14_224_2.5b

official_annotation_note: Food-101 train contains the benchmark's known noisy labels; official test annotations were cleaned by the dataset authors

official_source_splits.test: local validation (the Hugging Face name for official test)

reported_metrics.top-1: micro accuracy; used for LR-head selection

representation: final normalized CLS before the MetaCLIP 2 768-to-512 projection
resume_augmentation_note: the planned process boundary after every epoch restores head, optimizer, scheduler, and sampler position, but restarts DataLoader worker augmentation RNG; this epoch-barrier trajectory intentionally differs from one uninterrupted 10-epoch process. An unplanned mid-epoch resume is not bitwise identical
split_algorithm: for class ids 0..100, apply one numpy default_rng(seed) permutation; take the first 100 indices for validation and the remaining 650 for train; sort both resulting index arrays
test_policy: evaluate only after training using the head selected on final validation; never use official test for model or LR selection
train_split: official train minus fixed held-out validation
validation_head_selection: best validation micro top-1 over 13 LR heads
validation_split: fixed class-stratified subset of official train
